name: Wins
tagline: Snap, preview, and switch between windows on macOS.
description:
Wins is a macOS window manager that integrates into System Settings. Drag a window to a screen edge or into a Snap Island layout to arrange it. Dock Preview shows the open windows for an app when you hover over its Dock icon. Cmd-Tab Plus and Mission Control Pro let you switch to or close windows from the keyboard.

## Where it fits

Wins is useful for people who frequently rearrange windows or switch between several windows of the same app. It combines window tiling with Dock previews and window switching.

## Privacy and requirements

Wins requires macOS 12 Monterey or later and supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs. It uses Accessibility to manage windows, and window thumbnails require optional Screen Recording permission. The developer says window data stays on the Mac. Wins connects to check for updates and validate licenses.

## Pricing

Wins offers a one-day free trial. Single starts at $19.99 and includes one year of updates. Pro and X are also one-time purchases and include lifetime updates.
